title: Is Visual Prompting All You Need? Studying VLM Spatial Reasoning under Progressive Visual Scaffolds
abstract: arXiv:2608.21170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in multimodal reasoning, yet recent work shows that their failures often reflect an interaction between visual grounding and downstream reasoning. What remains less clear is how the visual presentation of a task shapes model performance and failure modes when the underlying reasoning problem is unchanged. We study this question in SPaRC, a benchmark for grid-based visual spatial planning, by introducing lightweight input-side scaffolds that preserve the visual modality while making spatial structure more accessible. Across multiple VLMs, these scaffolds improve task accuracy over the original visual setting by up to 34.0 percentage points and further complement GRPO-based training, yielding up to 4.6 additional accuracy points compared with near-zero gains on the original visual input. Analyses on both end-to-end task solving and object detection show that these gains are closely tied

translated_title: 视觉提示就够了吗？在渐进式视觉支架下研究VLM空间推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21170v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：视觉语言模型（VLMs）在多模态推理方面取得了快速进展，但近期研究表明，它们的失败往往反映了视觉基础与下游推理之间的交互。尚不清楚的是，当底层推理问题不变时，任务的视觉呈现方式如何影响模型性能和失败模式。我们在SPaRC（一个基于网格的视觉空间规划基准）中研究了这个问题，通过引入轻量级输入侧支架，这些支架保留视觉模态，同时使空间结构更易于访问。在多个VLM中，这些支架相对于原始视觉设置将任务准确率提高了多达34.0个百分点，并进一步补充了基于GRPO的训练，相较于原始视觉输入上的近乎零增益，额外提高了多达4.6个准确率点。对端到端任务求解和物体检测的分析表明，这些增益与视觉结构紧密相关。
tldr: 本文通过引入轻量级视觉支架显著提升了VLM在空间规划任务中的表现，证明了视觉呈现方式对模型推理能力的关键影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces lightweight visual scaffolds that significantly boost VLM performance in spatial planning tasks, demonstrating the critical role of visual presentation in model reasoning.
